problem: Compound cubes retain input restoration, literal inversion, and output inversion, causing a longer critical path than unary clusters.
method: 32 consecutive setup/target phases with retained history, both input-to-rear/side assignments, each complete simulation repeated exactly. Three public output lamps and their driver dust observed separately.
findings: Direct subtract comparator with two distinct owned strong primary supports realizes rear AND NOT side at 0/15 input strengths. Composite AND uses a comparator inverter driving strong side support; both aligned and direct rear variants are correct and glitch-free in this study.
limits: Automatic compiler selection remains disabled. Composite AND is still an independent, uncertified study. No simulator semantics, waveform caps or timing holds changed.
next: Investigate compound AND using an independently certified primitive-driven side-strength contract; current direct subtraction contract accepts only two distinct primary-owned floor lever supports.
